⚠️ If you receive a file named RTO Challan.apk, RTO E Challan.apk or MParivahan.apk on WhatsApp or SMS, do not install it.

Cybercriminals are using fake traffic challan apps to spread malware. Once installed and given permissions, such malware can try to access SMS, OTPs, notifications and banking-related information. In some cases, a compromised WhatsApp account can also be used to spread the same scam to your contacts.

Always verify traffic challans only through the official e-Challan portal or authorised government apps.

If you have already installed a suspicious APK, disconnect the internet, remove the app, change important banking passwords and UPI PINs, and report financial fraud immediately on 1930.

Share this with your family and WhatsApp groups.
